LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B / B2C - Lists the orders linked to an Account or Contact. Top block shows the latest order with its line items; bottom block is a compact history with search / sort / status filter / View all. Bilingual EN / FR.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls every built-in string (headers, buttons, sort labels, empty states).

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the dictionary default ('Orders' / 'Commandes').

property.name: statusFilter
property.label: Status whitelist (CSV, optional)
property.description: Comma-separated list of Order.Status values. When set, only orders matching these statuses are shown, and a status picker appears above the history list. Leave empty to allow every status.

property.name: defaultSort
property.label: Default sort
property.description: One of: EffectiveDate DESC | EffectiveDate ASC | TotalAmount DESC | TotalAmount ASC | OrderNumber ASC | OrderNumber DESC.

property.name: productImageFieldApiName
property.label: Product image field API name
property.description: Field on Product2 holding the image URL. Schema-safe - skipped if absent.

property.name: productImageFallbackUrl
property.label: Product image fallback URL
property.description: Used when the product image field is empty or absent.
